description: This file defines a generic durable list data structure with serialization, versioning, and state machine capabilities, including interfaces, classes, and methods for list manipulation and persistence.

classes.name: IDurableList<T>
classes.description: Interface for a durable list supporting range addition and read-only view.

classes.name: DurableList<T>
classes.description: Implementation of a durable, versioned list with serialization and state machine support.

classes.name: IDurableCollectionDebugView<T>
classes.description: Debug view class for inspecting the collection in debugging tools.

methods.name: AddRange
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the list.

methods.name: AsReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a read-only wrapper around the list.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine with a new log writer.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the list state.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends log entries for the current state.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Appends a snapshot of the current list state.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the list.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the list.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the list items to an array.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for the list.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of an item.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item at a specified index.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the list.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the list (not implemented).
